title: JS Store Root Class
description: Make semio/js expose Store as the root owner for GraphQL transport and keep Kit beneath the Version interface shape from target.schema.graphql.
summary: Removed root-era helper names such as KitGraphql/kitGraphql/__kitGraphqlEnvelope/rootKit, moved synchronous Kit access under TheKit.kit(), aligned GraphQL reads/subscriptions to Query.store/Subscription.store, and kept downstream React/algorithms adapters on openStore/useWipKit.
